description: This file is a React component named 'SimpleVCTag' that displays the status of a verification credential (VC) or workflow verification. It includes UI elements for showing verification status, and buttons for downloading or copying VC data, with logic for handling these actions.

methods.name: SimpleVCTag
methods.description: React functional component that displays VC status and provides actions like download and copy.

methods.name: getStatusConfig
methods.description: Determines the visual representation based on the verification status.

methods.name: handleDownload
methods.description: Handles the logic for downloading the VC or workflow compliance report.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Handles copying the VC data to clipboard.
